description:
A privacy violation has been flagged in case 'Privacy Compliance Review - Ticket #8842'. The intake clerk accidentally included the complainant's phone number in the public Description field.

Your task:
1. Find the case titled 'Privacy Compliance Review - Ticket #8842' (you may need to use the Search module or Global Search).
2. Edit the Description/Details field.
3. Replace the phone number (format 202-555-xxxx) with the exact text '[REDACTED]'.
4. Save the case.

Do not delete the rest of the description text; only the phone number should be replaced.
